What agencies use FormflowX for

Client intake

Collect company name, goals, budget, timeline, and file uploads (brand assets, existing materials) in a structured multi-step form. Beats a 20-email back-and-forth every time.

Client intake template →

Project brief

Brief forms tailored to your service — web design, copywriting, social — with conditional questions that only appear for the relevant deliverable type.

How conditional logic works →

Revision & approval

Send clients a form after each deliverable: approve, or provide structured revision notes. No more "looks great but can you just..." arriving at 11pm as an email.

Feedback template →

End-of-project satisfaction

Automatically trigger a satisfaction survey when a project closes. Capture NPS, testimonials, and referral permission — while the work is still fresh.

NPS template →
Why agencies choose FormflowX

Professional forms without the enterprise price tag

Custom branding, free

Remove FormflowX branding and use your own logo and colours on every form. Clients see your brand, not ours.

File uploads

Clients attach brand guidelines, assets, reference images, and documents directly in the form. No more "please email the files separately".

Notion integration free

Every intake, brief, and feedback response creates a Notion database entry. Your project tracker stays current without any manual data entry.

Slack alerts

Know the instant a client submits a brief or approval. Your account manager gets a Slack message with key details — no email inbox monitoring required.

Smart conditional forms

Show web design clients different brief questions than copywriting clients. One form, multiple paths — clients only answer what's relevant.

Flat-rate pricing

No per-submission fees. Whether you run 5 or 500 client projects a month, the price doesn't change. Pro is $15/month flat.
